explicitExclusions.reason: Secret values were intentionally not accessed; only file existence, size, and mode metadata were inspected.
Vendored install output was excluded; package.json and the integrity-pinned lockfile were reviewed instead.
No production Lirunex portal, Supabase database, Railway runtime, registry, or real customer data was accessed.

surfaces.label: Broker status eligibility
surfaces.notes: The scraper overwrites the portal Status column with Active before the license gate.

surfaces.label: Deposit currency and units
surfaces.notes: USC and configured USD values are compared without currency or unit normalization.

surfaces.label: Browser concurrency and resource control
surfaces.notes: Every accepted request immediately launches Chromium with no global in-flight limit.

surfaces.label: Container build secret boundary
surfaces.notes: The full local context, including a normal .env, can be copied into the final image.

surfaces.label: Request and broker-data logging
surfaces.notes: Unauthenticated multiline input reaches logs, and successful searches log a complete raw broker row.

surfaces.label: HMAC and session cryptography
surfaces.notes: Timing-safe HMAC verification and AES-256-GCM are effective. Replay and session-file concerns lacked a realistic added privilege or impact path.

surfaces.label: Supabase authentication, RLS, and service-role ordering
surfaces.notes: User tokens, body-user binding, rate limits, runtime controls, and active-program checks precede privileged writes; the migration adds no new RLS exposure.

surfaces.label: Dependencies and deployment guidance
surfaces.notes: Integrity-pinned lockfiles were clean. Mutable installation guidance and root-runtime concerns require operator or upstream compromise and did not survive the reportability policy.
